I wrote a one-paragraph `README.md` describing the project as a seed fixture for gisting E0 sessions: a trivial Python calculator paired with the `.project/` governance + telemetry harness that drives an autonomous multi-agent delivery workflow. I described only what's actually present (the two governance YAMLs, the telemetry file, and the calc module), and kept the existing title.
